problems_addressed.problem: False jetty shade across bare firewall
problems_addressed.repair: Intersect each shadow with its casting jetty frontage and receiving facade, excluding reserved masonry bays. Passing shadow PNGs are unchanged.

problems_addressed.problem: Rotated highlights and equal-value L planes
problems_addressed.repair: Repeat the approved gable paired planes without rotation. Use separate image-painted shaded north and lit south fill planes; retain the source-defined gutter channel and the unmirrored south hip. All three colours have distinct opposing values in greyscale.
Use full masonry bays only where an intact frontage fits. W1 tall/low pairs and a W2 tall between two W1 lows use four-pixel blank-edge masonry returns; central windows and doors remain unchanged.

Scene composites final accents after all opaque joins at the owning base row; later base rows retain occlusion. The dormer and chimney were mounted on the final L receiving planes, clear of its ridge.
